newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cifra shareholders approve Wal-Mart merger.
newsitem.headline: Cifra shareholders approve Wal-Mart merger.

text.p: Shareholders of Mexican retailer Cifra approved the merger of the company's joint venture with Wal-Mart and an annual dividend payment of 0.75 pesos per each of the 3.2 billion shares in circulation.

In an assembly on Tuesday, Cifra also approved the increase of Cifra's capital stock by 1.609 billion shares, to be given to Wal-Mart as payment for the merger, according to a report by Mexican brokerage Valores Finamex.
It said Wal-Mart will in addition hold a public tender offer for Cifra Series A and B shares at a price of between $1.89 and $2.03 for a total investment of about $1.2 billion.
With the share purchase, Wal-Mart will hold a controlling stake in Cifra of 46 percent of the company.
